info.title: FuelWatch API
info.description: Independent, read-only API maintained by Bradley Hodges. Fuel prices originate from fuelwatch.wa.gov.au. This document describes the Worker source contract, not a guarantee that a deployment already runs that source. All JSON timestamps use AWST (+08:00); HTTP dates retain protocol formatting.

tags.name: Prices
tags.description: Grouped station prices and public CORS.

get.description: Public read-only JSON:API 1.1 collection. No pagination, sort, include, fields or authentication. Default all products. Short aliases and expand are intentional JSON:API query-name extensions. Total URLSearchParams serialization must be at most 1024 characters. Source-filtered selections expand to at most 24 combinations; see filtering guide for the conditional rule.

get.description: Compatibility endpoint. Defaults to product 1; accepts the same six filters and aliases, but rejects expand. All selections use the 24-combination bound. String brands/features, separate per-product items, E.164 phone and optional product marker for multi-product requests. No JSON:API metadata or Google enrichment.

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: Exact filename advertised by an expanded brand; case-sensitive.

200.description: Public SVG. Existing assets are served before the Worker, without price/Google requests.

ETag.description: Opaque quoted validator for the complete representation. Send unchanged in If-None-Match.

405.description: Static assets support GET/HEAD. Existing images do not support OPTIONS.

200.description: Same headers as image GET; no body.

ProductCode.description: FuelWatch product identifier. There is no product 3. See the [product codes](/docs/api-reference/codes#products) for names.

BrandCode.description: FuelWatch brand code. Reserved response-only code 0 means unmapped; sourceNotes.brand retains its name. See the [brand codes](/docs/api-reference/codes#brands) for names.

FeatureCode.description: Stable API feature identifier; not an array position. See the [site feature codes](/docs/api-reference/codes#site-features) for names.

RestrictionCode.description: Stable API restriction identifier. See the [restriction codes](/docs/api-reference/codes#restrictions) for names.

logo.description: Root-relative SVG URL; resolve against the API origin.

postcode.description: Australian postcode, preserving leading zeroes; null when unavailable.

asAt.description: Start of the selected price period at 06:00 AWST; equals meta.validFrom.

1.description: Unleaded Petrol in Australian cents per litre.

2.description: Premium Unleaded 95 in Australian cents per litre.

4.description: Diesel in Australian cents per litre.

5.description: LPG in Australian cents per litre.

6.description: Premium Unleaded 98 in Australian cents per litre.

10.description: E85 in Australian cents per litre.

11.description: Brand Diesel in Australian cents per litre.

products.description: Selected product IDs as JSON string keys. Missing products are unavailable, never zero. 195.1 cents/L means AUD 1.951/L.

OpeningHours.description: Optional local AWST weekday schedule. Missing weekdays are unknown. End before start means next day; 24:00 is allowed only as a closing time.

Monday.description: Closed, or one or more comma-separated HH:mm-HH:mm intervals.

Tuesday.description: Closed, or one or more comma-separated HH:mm-HH:mm intervals.

Wednesday.description: Closed, or one or more comma-separated HH:mm-HH:mm intervals.

Thursday.description: Closed, or one or more comma-separated HH:mm-HH:mm intervals.

Friday.description: Closed, or one or more comma-separated HH:mm-HH:mm intervals.

Saturday.description: Closed, or one or more comma-separated HH:mm-HH:mm intervals.

Sunday.description: Closed, or one or more comma-separated HH:mm-HH:mm intervals.

SourceNotes.description: Optional original text that could not be represented by the controlled schema.

brand.description: Unmapped source brand, paired with code 0.

openHours.description: Unparsed source hours; blocks provider replacement.

phone.description: Invalid or ambiguous source phone; blocks provider replacement.

Enrichment.description: Present only when provider fields were used. Preserve attribution when displaying them.

stale.description: Provider refresh deadline has passed; data is still within its 30-day retention limit.

items.description: Field contributed by Google, such as phone, address.postcode or openHours.Monday.

googleMapsUri.description: Google Maps URL for the matched place.

brand.description: Numeric by default; object when brand is expanded.

is24Hours.description: true: known continuous opening; false: known limited schedule; null: unknown.

phone.description: Valid E.164 phone number, or null.

siteFeatures.description: Codes by default, objects when expanded. Empty is []; each nonempty array uses one representation.

restrictions.description: Codes or expanded objects; null when there are no known restrictions.

id.description: Opaque identity for one station and source date. Stable across selected products, expansion, prices and enrichment, but changes with source date or station identity.

fetchedAt.description: Oldest contributing origin fetch; never reset by cache reads.

validUntil.description: Exclusive end of the price period at 06:00 the next day.

publicationStatus.description: Nonempty, valid empty, or empty tomorrow selection before 14:30 AWST. Not a separate availability endpoint.

version.description: Worker package version that rendered this document. Distinct from the /v1 route and JSON:API version; cached documents can retain the previous version.

detail.description: Safe diagnostic message; do not branch on its wording.

LegacyItem.description: Validated RSS-shaped station quote. Source/parser members are preserved; quotes are not grouped by station.

price.description: Price in cents/L, as source text.

feed.description: RSS channel/parser metadata and validated items. Not a JSON:API document.

product.name: filter[product]
product.description: Selected fuels. Default: all seven on /v1, product 1 on /legacy. Names and text values are case-insensitive. Do not repeat this parameter or combine its two spellings.

productAlias.name: product
productAlias.description: Selected fuels. Default: all seven on /v1, product 1 on /legacy. Names and text values are case-insensitive. Do not repeat this parameter or combine its two spellings.

brand.name: filter[brand]
brand.description: Brand codes, not names. Code 0 is response-only. Omitted means all brands. Names and text values are case-insensitive. Do not repeat this parameter or combine its two spellings.

brandAlias.name: brand
brandAlias.description: Brand codes, not names. Code 0 is response-only. Omitted means all brands. Names and text values are case-insensitive. Do not repeat this parameter or combine its two spellings.

region.name: filter[region]
region.description: Region codes; selection is evaluated at the source. Names and text values are case-insensitive. Do not repeat this parameter or combine its two spellings.

regionAlias.name: region
regionAlias.description: Region codes; selection is evaluated at the source. Names and text values are case-insensitive. Do not repeat this parameter or combine its two spellings.

suburb.name: filter[suburb]
suburb.description: Suburb names; trims and collapses whitespace. Use surrounding=no for exact matching. Names and text values are case-insensitive. Do not repeat this parameter or combine its two spellings.

suburbAlias.name: suburb
suburbAlias.description: Suburb names; trims and collapses whitespace. Use surrounding=no for exact matching. Names and text values are case-insensitive. Do not repeat this parameter or combine its two spellings.

day.name: filter[day]
day.description: Perth yesterday, today or tomorrow; DD/MM/YYYY must resolve to one of those same three dates. Calendar selection changes at midnight; price validity starts at 06:00. Names and text values are case-insensitive. Do not repeat this parameter or combine its two spellings.

dayAlias.name: day
dayAlias.description: Perth yesterday, today or tomorrow; DD/MM/YYYY must resolve to one of those same three dates. Calendar selection changes at midnight; price validity starts at 06:00. Names and text values are case-insensitive. Do not repeat this parameter or combine its two spellings.

surrounding.name: filter[surrounding]
surrounding.description: yes or no. With a suburb, omission keeps upstream surrounding behavior. Without a suburb, does not restrict stations. Names and text values are case-insensitive. Do not repeat this parameter or combine its two spellings.

surroundingAlias.name: surrounding
surroundingAlias.description: yes or no. With a suburb, omission keeps upstream surrounding behavior. Without a suburb, does not restrict stations. Names and text values are case-insensitive. Do not repeat this parameter or combine its two spellings.

expand.name: expand
expand.description: Case-insensitive comma-separated brand, siteFeatures, restrictions, or all. Omitted means numeric codes. Trim and deduplicate members; all plus valid members is allowed. Unknown/empty members and repeated parameters return 400. This representation control never reaches RSS or D1 keys.

validator.name: If-None-Match
validator.description: ETag from the same URL/representation. Supports a list, weak prefix or *. A match returns a bodyless 304.

Success.description: Validated collection, including a valid empty data array.

NotModified.description: Representation matches If-None-Match. No body; retain the previously stored document and fetch time.

Error400.description: invalid_query: Unsupported, repeated or invalid query parameter.

Error404.description: not_found: Path or image does not exist.

Error405.description: method_not_allowed: Use GET, HEAD or supported OPTIONS preflight.

Error406.description: not_acceptable: Accept does not permit JSON:API.

Error502.description: invalid_feed: Source data failed validation or replaced published prices with an empty feed. response_too_large: Source selection exceeds bounded response limits. upstream_denied: Source refused the request.

Error503.description: upstream_unavailable: Source temporarily unavailable or unreachable. cache_refresh_busy: Another invocation holds the snapshot fill lease; retry shortly.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait, when supplied; cache_refresh_busy uses 2.

Error504.description: upstream_timeout: Source did not complete within the shared deadline.

ETag.description: Opaque quoted validator for the complete representation. Send unchanged in If-None-Match.

Cache-Control.description: public, max-age=0, s-maxage=<remaining seconds>, or no-store. Never assume six hours remains.

X-FuelWatch-Cache.description: Rendered edge response cache status for this request.

X-FuelWatch-Snapshot-Cache.description: D1 snapshot status when the representation was built; retained unchanged on an edge hit.

x-contract-notes: Case-insensitive query names and text values cannot be enforced by standard OpenAPI parameter matching.
Parameter aliases are mutually exclusive, repeated names are invalid, and list entries are trimmed and deduplicated.
expand controls whole-field representation; schemas allow either shape but cannot enforce its relationship to a request parameter.
For region queries or suburb queries without surrounding=no, product×brand×region×suburb combinations must not exceed 24.
Absolute query dates must be within yesterday/today/tomorrow in Australia/Perth at request time.
